name: chalette-dev
description: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.3.0 (2026-07-24) — CONSOL1: chalette-dev becomes the SINGLE canonical home of the shared QA/dev toolkit; the duplicate copies were removed from the private chalette plugin (which drifted). The 18 skills were reconciled to their canonical, operator-fenced form (newest-wins WITH fence preservation): operator profile gains chalette_clone / specs_dir / parking_doc keys plus a gitignored config/operator.local.json overlay — M's real-workspace profile lives ONLY in that overlay; the committed operator.json stays the contractor-safe default. ship-readiness-gate rebuilt on the operator pattern (default synthetic; real only when allowed_targets grants it); synthetic-workspace-runtime-test re-adds the event_gate_routed invariant (D6); triage-intake carries INTAKE1 F5 (resurrection guard, ported from chalette030) + F4 (chalette_clone, operator-aware) + specs_dir/parking_doc/may_ship-gated delivery; capture-for-code scopes its placeholder-names rule to non-real operators (F7); all real-path and M-identity leaks fenced. Two structural guards: scripts/check_toolkit_overlap.py (Guard 1 — fails if the toolkit re-duplicates into chalette) and tests/test_operator_fences.py (Guard 2 — fails if the committed operator.json drifts from contractor-safe, or if operator.local.json is tracked), both run in .github/workflows/toolkit-guard.yml (overlap check token-gated so forks stay green). quick_validate hygiene: template_version key removed from regenerate-skill / skill-generator / voice-test; regenerate-skill + skill-generator descriptions shrunk to the <=980 doctrine. Skill count unchanged (18). PRIOR HISTORY: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.2.1 (2026-07-24): FASTFOLLOW1 — post-review fixes. Intake pair (INTAKE1): capture-for-code duplicate-append is now restricted to matches in new/ (a match in needs-input/ or speced/ gets a fresh pointer file in new/ instead, preserving the single-writer rule), specs/ added to the first-capture folder bootstrap, and the confirm-line example points at the real ~/cr-intake/new/ queue root. cr-skill-builder v3 text fixes (SB1, kept byte-synced with chalette030): Gate-3 event-write wording corrected (a direct atomic_append_jsonl on the events path is gated, not banned), stale 'Gate 17' runtime-exercise heading corrected to Gate 13, the python-eaten-escapes gotcha tagged '(instruction-layer)', and stale Desktop/Claude output/workspace paths repointed to Penelopes Brain. skill-creator '20-gate' reference swept to '27-gate' to match chalette030. Removed bug-regression-suite/references/cr-investigation-2026-05-30/ + discovery-log-2026-05-29.md (real-name audit residue; deletion-forward, git-history purge pending M ruling). Skill count unchanged (18). v0.2.0 (2026-07-23): +2 skills — the intake pair: capture-for-code (one-minute structured capture of a bug/idea/skill-want into a local Maildir-style queue at operator.json intake_root, default ~/cr-intake; folder=status, single-writer, hypotheses always UNVERIFIED-labeled, placeholder names only) + triage-intake (verify each capture against the cr1 clone — graduated L1 read-trace / L2 test slice / L3 synthetic-fixture repro, same-class sweep, verdicts CONFIRMED / COULD-NOT-REPRODUCE / NOT-A-BUG — then emit a sized build spec, bug ≤1pg or feature ≤3pg with §0 recommended-default decisions, delivered to M via PR; contractors never self-approve specs into builds, synthetic targets only per allowed_targets). operator.json gains intake_root. Skill count 16→18. v0.1.3 (2026-07-15): bug-regression-suite catalog +1 entry — Bug #105 (_pid_alive fired a real Ctrl+C on Windows; os.kill(pid,0) == CTRL_C_EVENT, blocked the Windows battery outright and defeated multi_write_context mutual exclusion under Cowork's no-console path; cr1 ae399e8 / PR #30). First code-level catalog entry: the battery is the repro, not a prompt fire. NOTE: this diverges the catalog from the private chalette plugin (v0.8.10) until M mirrors it — the byte-identical invariant is intentionally broken here and needs a sync. v0.1.2 (2026-07-14): bug-regression-suite catalog +3 integration-2026-07 entries (F-15 widget-transport instruction gap, F-08 no-email inference ban, F-12 apply-choices non-Gmail substrate writes), Bug #104 update (delegation confirmed live; EW2+T pass criteria), instruction-layer Methodology note — catalog stays byte-identical with the private chalette plugin (v0.8.10). 16 skills extracted from the private chalette plugin (v0.8.8, 2026-07-13): release verification (verify-cr-release, ship-readiness-gate, synthetic-workspace-runtime-test, compare-canonical-vs-freelance), test batteries (cr-test, run-command-room-tests, bug-regression-suite, cross-skill-interaction-test, scale-stress-test, smoke-watch), skill building (cr-skill-builder, skill-creator, skill-generator, regenerate-skill, voice-test), and preview-command-room-widget. Operator-aware: reads config/operator.json for identity, paths, and permitted test targets — non-M operators always test against synthetic fixtures, never a real workspace. Shipping/promote (ship-cr-plugin) deliberately NOT included — releases stay with M.
